signature_differences.box_kernel: refusal is BlurError::Parameter (not Option). MAX_BOX_KERNEL_TAPS 6001 = composite's MAX_EFFECT_TAPS, so Fast Box Blur radius 30000 hard max is still refused above 6001 taps
signature_differences.find_edges_window: no SampleRange parameter (unit range only: 1 - m refers to the white point); returns FilterError
signature_differences.directional/radial: as requested; each has a *_cost function for admission before the call
signature_differences.radial amount: accepts the full AE hard range 0..=1000; composite maps AE Amount 1:1 (a refusal 'Radial Blur amount > 0' can be dropped)

declared_readings.common: premultiplied work, straight in/out, transparent beyond src_rect, binary64 sums in fixed order rounded once to binary32, each output pixel independent of the window; sub-pixel filter SUBPIXEL_FILTER = bilinear_premultiplied, pixel (x,y) centred at (x+0.5, y+0.5)
declared_readings.box_kernel: three iterations ~ Gaussian of variance h(h+1): max tap error <= 10% of peak, L1 <= 0.06 (measured 9.2%/0.052 at h=1, 6.3%/0.051 at h=25)
declared_readings.blur_window_axis: one separable pass, unpremultiplied after the pass; H then V == blur_window_in within 1e-6 (straight round trip between passes)
declared_readings.directional: uniform weights over 2*ceil(L/2)+1 samples spaced L/(2m) on a segment of length L centred on the pixel; angle from +x towards screen-up (direction (cos, -sin)), exact at multiples of 90; angle 0 with L=2h == box_kernel(h,1) horizontal. AE Direction 0 meaning (AE may treat 0 as vertical) UNVERIFIED: composite maps the AE angle
declared_readings.radial: mean of 2m+1 samples per pixel, m = min(ceil(extent/2), 256) (spacing <= 1 px below the cap); spin arc 0.36*amount degrees (1000 = full turn), zoom scales 1 +- amount/2000, both centred on the pixel; AE amount unit, sample counts and Antialiasing quality UNVERIFIED (D5)
declared_readings.find_edges: FIND_EDGES_OPERATOR: per premultiplied colour channel 3x3 Sobel, replicated border, m = clamp(sqrt(gx^2+gy^2)/4, 0, 1); colour 1 - m (dark edges on white), invert -> m; alpha = source alpha; alpha 0 -> transparent. AE/PS formula UNVERIFIED (D5)
declared_readings.out_of_scope: Camera Lens Blur (no record); Find Edges Blend With Original (composite lerps)

notes.determinism: sin_cos only for non-quadrant directional angles and spin samples (platform binary64 libm, as brush/liquify/style already use); sqrt is IEEE
